role: Mendelson's primitive object-language implication in a first-order language
notes: Exact source notation of Mendelson 1997, Section 2.1, p. 52 and Section 2.3, p. 69. Within this scope it plays the role that \(\to\) plays on sheet:hilbert-fol; when a wf is evaluated with def:p02-fol-satisfaction it is read as \(\to\). Same glyph as the registered P7 parallel-reduction and P10/P12 rows; scopes are disjoint and the roles differ. Parenthesis-omission conventions are the source's (p. 52).

role: Mendelson's universal quantifier with parenthesized prefix
notes: Source notation, Mendelson 1997, Section 2.1, p. 52; existential (\exists x) is an abbreviation of \neg(\forall x)\neg there. Same role as the handbook's \forall.

role: Mendelson's consequence relation of a first-order theory K (deduction from hypotheses with unrestricted Gen)
notes: Mendelson 1997, Section 1.4, pp. 34-35. Not the derivability relation of sheet:hilbert-fol: Gen may quantify a variable free in a hypothesis. Subscript dropped when K is fixed (Section 2.4, p. 71).

role: metavariables for wfs of a first-order language
notes: Mendelson's script capitals (Section 2.3, p. 69). \mathscr E ranges over members of Gamma in the extension and its proof.
Mendelson 1997, Section 2.4, pp. 73-74. Distinct from the metavariable \mathscr D of the axiom schemas by its index.

role: a wf with x_i possibly free and the result of replacing the free occurrences of x_i by the term t
notes: Mendelson 1997, Section 2.1, p. 54. Replacement of occurrences without renaming, used only when t is free for x_i; not the handbook's capture-avoiding operation \(\varphi[t/x]\).

role: predicate letters function letters and individual constants of a first-order language
notes: Mendelson 1997, Section 2.2, p. 57; superscript = number of arguments. Read as relation, function and constant symbols of the corresponding signature in sec:p02-w02c-p02-017-failure.

role: individual variables of a first-order language
notes: Mendelson 1997, Section 2.2, p. 57. In the annex x_m is the quantified variable of a Gen step.

role: a first-order language in Mendelson's sense
notes: Mendelson 1997, Section 2.2, p. 57. Distinct from the handbook signature macro \Lang; its wfs are read in such a signature only in sec:p02-w02c-p02-017-failure.

role: the two hypotheses of the worked deduction
notes: Local abbreviations for (\forall x_1)(\mathscr B\Rightarrow\mathscr C) and (\forall x_1)\mathscr B.

role: piece of the deduction constructed in the proof of the deduction theorem
notes: Annex-local; ends with \mathscr B\Rightarrow\mathscr D_i. Same glyph as the script \mathscr E only in shape family; different alphabet and role.

role: subsequence deduction of the steps not depending upon the discharged wf
notes: Annex-local; S_j is built from the initial segment ending at step j.
